definitions.explanation: Clean, clear water welling up from the ground or flowing from rocks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{清水|しみず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}いている→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧。
examples.english: Clear water is welling up from between the rocks.
I washed my face in mountain spring water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅人|たびびと}→旅人：12725_tabibito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{街道|かいどう}→街道：14040_kaidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脇|わき}→脇：03790_waki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧{清水|しみず}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{潤|うるお}した→潤す：08249_uruosu⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: Travellers in the old days are said to have quenched their thirst at springs beside the highway.

notes:
A rather literary word; in everyday speech, ⟦{湧|わ}き{水|みず}→湧き水：18173_wakimizu⟧ is more common. Also a very common surname and place name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清水|しみず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧: clear water wells up
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{清水|しみず}: mountain spring water

WATCH OUT:
In the temple name ⟦{清水寺|きよみずでら}→清水寺：31028_kiyomizudera⟧ and the idiom {清水|きよみず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{飛|と}び{降|お}りる→飛び降りる：06734_tobioriru⟧ (to take the plunge), {清水|きよみず} is read きよみず.
